purpose: Seven watched 2026 House district geometries, with version guards and rendering semantics. Not a national district map.
attribution: Geometry: U.S. Census Bureau, 2025 Cartographic Boundary Files and 2026 TIGER/Line CD120; converted to GeoJSON.
processing: GDAL 3.10.3 ogr2ogr; transform EPSG:4269 to EPSG:4326, RFC7946, coordinate precision 6; filter exactly 50 states or seven requested district features; no synthetic polygons and no extra simplification. Compact JSON; normalized string IDs and explicitly labeled source vintages.

known_exclusions: 50-state geometry excludes DC, Puerto Rico, and other territories.
Watched district artifact contains only AZ06, CA22, CO08, MI07, NJ07, NY17, PA07, not all 435 districts.
No Missouri CD120 asset was downloaded or shipped because Census documents its TIGER files as stale for the 2026 general election.
quality_notes: The 20m and 5m geometries are official generalized thematic display layers, not precise voting-address tools.
GeoJSON follows RFC7946 ring winding. Libraries with opposite spherical winding expectations must handle that explicitly, not reverse at random.
Alaska crosses the antimeridian. Use a recognized US composite projection / clearly labeled AK and HI insets rather than dropping islands.
Census congressional page lists an August 28, 2026 last-revised footer but contains October 2026 notes. Source observation date is recorded separately from footer date.
Census Missouri narrative says September 23. The verified Supreme Court final per curiam is dated September 25, 2026.
